faq.question: Q1. What is the organization recruiting for?
faq.answer: The All India Institute of Medical Sciences Delhi (AIIMS Delhi) is recruiting for various positions. This recruitment drive is for a research project on COPD, offering an excellent opportunity in the healthcare sector.

faq.question: Q2. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment drive by AIIMS Delhi is Clinical Research Coordinator. Candidates with relevant qualifications are encouraged to apply for this specific role.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are available for the Clinical Research Coordinator post?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Clinical Research Coordinator post at AIIMS Delhi. Interested candidates should ensure they meet all eligibility criteria before applying.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Delhi Clinical Research Coordinator Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Clinical Research Coordinator post at AIIMS Delhi is 12 September 2026. Candidates must ensure their applications are sent via email before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for the AIIMS Delhi Clinical Research Coordinator recruitment is Email. Candidates need to send their complete application along with required documents to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q6. What are the educational qualifications required for the Clinical Research Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Bachelor's Degree in a relevant subject with 2 years of experience in the relevant field, OR a Master's Degree in a relevant subject. These are the minimum qualifications for the post.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for the Clinical Research Coordinator post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Clinical Research Coordinator post is 35 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST (5 years) and OBC (3 years) categories as per government rules.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary for the Clinical Research Coordinator post at AIIMS Delhi?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Clinical Research Coordinator post will receive a salary of ₹30,000/- per month. This project-based position is initially until February 2029.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Clinical Research Coordinator post at AIIMS Delhi involves two main stages: shortlisting of eligible candidates based on their applications, followed by an interview for the shortlisted individuals.

faq.question: Q10. How can I apply for the AIIMS Delhi Clinical Research Coordinator recruitment?
faq.answer: To apply, candidates should email their resume to [email protected]. It is crucial to mention "Clinical Research Coordinator" in the email's subject line. Ensure all required documents are attached.
